# Vendored browser dependencies

## fengari-web.js (v0.1.4)

MIT — https://github.com/fengari-lua/fengari-web/releases/download/v0.1.4/fengari-web.js

Loaded by `index.html` before the ES module bootstrap; exposes `globalThis.fengari` for `js/nhl_lua.js` in the browser.

Re-fetch: `bash tools/vendor-fengari-web.sh`
